event_case: Vision 7 program loading and free test key hotfix

items.text: Failure in an unrelated Vision 7 endpoint must not leave product choices loading forever or block manual program creation
items.acceptance: programs load independently secondary requests use allSettled and degraded mode remains usable

items.text: When product choices are unavailable Boss can still create an app with unbound lifetime monthly and yearly plans
items.acceptance: four product mappings are forcibly empty and a visible retry warning is shown

items.text: Key issuance must offer a free test key after selecting the app
items.acceptance: test mode states no charge and customer mode shows the selected package sale price
